verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST endpoint for programmatic request queries (POST /v1/request/query) with a published OpenAPI spec. Its pricing page lists HQL, and a community report confirms users can write SQL against its ClickHouse store, so an agent could pull logged request data through an API. However, there is no evidence of an official MCP server, and querying session traces, aggregate metrics, or eval results via API is not specifically documented. Missing for 10: official MCP server, documented API access to session/trace trees, metrics endpoints, eval-result query endpoints, hands-on evidence of agent-driven debugging.
